question: Create a Manhattan plot from GWAS summary statistics. Plot -log10(p-value) against genomic position, grouped by chromosome. Highlight genome-wide significant SNPs (p < 5x10^-8) in red.

expected_output.guidelines: Manhattan plot must show -log10(p-value) vs chromosomal position with SNPs grouped by chromosome and a genome-wide significance threshold (p < 5e-8) visually marked; chromosome colors, significance-SNP marking style, and font may differ.
